what: sheet.hem with its own gap of 1 mm (an open hem), flipped, on the top edge of a 100 x 60 x 2 base, 10 long
method: gap g = 1 is the inner radius; flip turns a top-edge hem over the top face: bend axis at (y 0, z T + g = 3), outer radius g + T = 3 (to y = -3), the leg 10 - 3 = 7 long at z T + 2g .. 2T + 2g = 4 .. 6. V = 100*60*2 + (pi/2)(3^2 - 1^2)*100 + 7*100*2 = 14656.637061
